messages:
sarah (CS): Hey team — enterprise customer hit a 422 on our /v1/rerank endpoint. They included a repro and say our error is unclear. Pasting minimal curl + payload they used:

customer-bot: POST /v1/rerank 422 response:
```
HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
{"error":{"type":"invalid_request","message":"Ambiguous input: both 'documents' and 'candidates' detected at multiple nesting levels"}}
```

olivia (Support): Repro payload from customer (redacted ids):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "question": "How do I reset my password?",
    "documents": [
      {
        "doc_id": "doc_1",
        "title": "Reset steps",
        "passages": [
          {"pid": "p_1", "text": "Go to settings > account"}
        ],
        "candidates": [
          {"cid": "c_1", "text": "Reset via email link"}
        ]
      }
    ]
  }'
```

sarah (CS): Note they used top-level "question" (not "query") and also nested "candidates" inside each document while also sending top-level "documents". Our validator threw the ambiguous input error. Customer expected that sending document-scoped candidates would be allowed for rerank.

mike (ML Eng): Quick clarification: our rerank API supports two canonical shapes: either (A) top-level "query" + top-level "candidates" array (flat list to score), or (B) top-level "query" + top-level "documents" where each document optionally has a "passages" array (for passage-level reranking). We do not accept mixed shapes where both top-level candidates and nested candidates are present because it's ambiguous which objects to score. Also we expect the query field to be named "query"; "question" is not currently aliased.

james (Platform Eng): The 422 message is coming from our input schema check. Current message is terse and doesn't point to the exact path. We should provide a more actionable error like: "Use top-level 'candidates' (flat re-ranking) or top-level 'documents' with per-document 'passages' (document->passage reranking). Do not nest 'candidates' inside 'documents' when also sending top-level 'documents'. Rename 'question' to 'query'."

olivia (Support): Customer also says they often transform their search results into a single object that merges metadata and candidate lists per doc. They wanted to avoid an extra ETL step.

mike (ML Eng): Two actionable options for them:
1) Transform to flat candidates client-side before calling /v1/rerank. Example canonical payload for flat rerank:
```json
{
  "query": "How do I reset my password?",
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c_1", "text": "Reset via email link", "metadata": {"source_doc": "doc_1"}},
    {"id": "c_2", "text": "Use company SSO", "metadata": {"source_doc": "doc_2"}}
  ]
}
```
2) Use document->passage reranking: keep top-level "documents" and put smaller text units into "passages". Example:
```json
{
  "query": "How do I reset my password?",
  "documents": [
    {"id": "doc_1", "passages": [{"id":"p_1","text":"Go to settings > account"}]},
    {"id": "doc_2", "passages": [{"id":"p_2","text":"Contact support to reset"}]}
  ]
}
```

james (Platform Eng): Also noticed their request had ~1,200 nested candidate objects across docs. Our current candidate limit is 1000 per request for flat lists; when they flatten it they should watch that limit. If they need >1000 we can suggest batching or a dedicated capacity plan.

olivia (Support): Customer asked if we can accept "question" as alias for "query" to avoid changing their ETL.

mike (ML Eng): Short-term we can accept aliasing on the server: treat top-level "question" as "query" for 30 days and return a deprecation warning header. Medium-term: docs update + example snippets.

sarah (CS): Action items:
- james: improve 422 error text to include which fields conflict and recommend the canonical shapes (ETA today) :eyes:
- mike: add temporary alias for "question" -> "query" and deprecation header (ETA tomorrow)
- olivia: send customer the two canonical payloads + note about 1000 candidate limit and batching options

customer-bot: Quick follow-up from customer after trying flat payload: "worked after flattening and dropping to ~800 candidates. thanks! :thumbsup:"

sarah (CS): Great — will track PRs for the server error message and alias. Leaving this thread open until docs are updated.

james (Platform Eng): Filed infra ticket #INF-3245 to improve validator message and include the conflicting JSON paths. Will also add unit test for nested-candidates rejection.

mike (ML Eng): I'll add the deprecation alias and a warning header value: X-Redwood-Warn: "'question' is deprecated, use 'query'".

sarah (CS): Closing loop with customer now. Thanks everyone.
